text:
Which statement about the transfer of thermal energy is correct?
A
All metals conduct thermal energy equally well.
B
Convection can only occur in solids or liquids.
C
Convection occurs in liquids because hot liquid is more dense than cold liquid.
D
The radiation that transfers thermal energy is a type of electromagnetic radiation.

options.label: A
options.text: All metals conduct thermal energy equally well.

options.label: B
options.text: Convection can only occur in solids or liquids.

options.label: C
options.text: Convection occurs in liquids because hot liquid is more dense than cold liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: The radiation that transfers thermal energy is a type of electromagnetic radiation.
